test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which feature of the Indian Constitution has been taken from the Constitution of Japan?

options.text: Impeachment of the President and Supreme Court Justices

solution:
The correct answer is __**Procedure established by law**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• It means that a** law has been duly enacted by the competent body following the correct procedure**. For example, the procedure mentioned in the constitution.
 
• The Doctrine of Procedure established by law has been taken from the Japanese Constitution.
 
• Later after Judicial Interpretation, we adopted the idea of due process of law. It is a wider concept than procedure established by law and it was adopted from the American Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 21: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty**

 
 
• This article declares that **no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to the procedure established by law**.
 
• This right is available to **both citizens and non-citizens**.
 
• The right to life is not merely confined to animal existence or survival but also includes the right to live with **human dignity** and all those aspects of life which go to make a man’s life meaningful, complete, and worth living.
